## Gnoll Lieutenant (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
Gnoll fighter 5  
CE Medium humanoid (gnoll)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 11, flat-footed 19 (+6 armor, +1 Dex, +1 natural, +2 shield)  
**hp** 55 (7 HD; 2d8+5d10+19)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +3, **Will** +2 (+1 vs. fear)  
**Defensive Abilities** bravery +1  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** +1 scorpion whip +14/+9 (1d4 +9)  
**Ranged** mwk pepperbox rifle +8/+3 (1d10/x4)  
**Special Attacks** weapon training (flails +1)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** The gnoll lieutenant demoralizes foes and lashes out with his scorpion whip from a distance. If fighting at range, he applies oil of magic weapon to his rifle and lays down deadly bursts of fire.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 20, **Dex** 12, **Con** 15, **Int** 6, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Dazzling Display, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Improved Whip Mastery, Intimidating Prowess, Weapon Focus (whip), Whip Mastery, [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Intimidate +16  
**Languages** Gnoll  
**SQ** armor training 1  
**Combat Gear** potions of cure light wounds (2), oil of magic weapon (2), alchemist’s fire (3); **Other Gear** ultraweave armor, buckler, +1 scorpion whip, masterwork pepperbox rifle with 20 metal cartridges, cloak of resistance +1, 15 gp
